semantics.universal_rule: Every task-like work unit is represented as a Project.
semantics.recursive_rule: A Project may contain child Projects recursively.
semantics.no_task_entity_rule: There is no separate canonical Task entity duplicating Project semantics.
semantics.meaning_rule: Labels such as task, subtask, phase, milestone or work package are role/view semantics over Project where needed.
semantics.identity_rule: Each Project has explicit stable identity.
semantics.composition_rule: Higher-level work is composed from child Projects rather than duplicated into parallel work primitives.

invariants.rule: Project/task, execution, evidence and merit semantics are explicit and non-duplicated.

hard_gates.condition: separate Task entity duplicates Project semantics
subtask/phase/milestone modeled as incompatible primitive without irreducible semantics
Project identity inferred from display label/path only
Project hierarchy inferred solely from filesystem/UI nesting

references.purpose: Reuse one recursive Project primitive instead of parallel task concepts.
